title: ColdProof Golden Evidence Replay Blueprint
purpose: Define the behavior, evidence requirements, synthetic context, assumptions, provenance rules and validation invariants required to build the CP-DEMO-001 benchmark.

benchmark_scope.primary_goal: Evaluate whether ColdProof can ingest, normalize, organize, trace and evaluate heterogeneous cold-chain evidence without altering the underlying observed measurements.

test_objectives.name: measurement_provenance
test_objectives.description: Every observed measurement used by the scenario must remain traceable to its original public source asset and raw row or workbook cell.

test_objectives.name: multi_segment_evidence_replay
test_objectives.description: A single synthetic batch and shipment must be organized into four ordered synthetic logistics segments.

test_objectives.name: handover_workflow
test_objectives.description: Three synthetic handover boundaries must exist between the four logistics segments.

test_objectives.name: temperature_rule_evaluation
test_objectives.description: The selected time-series evidence should contain meaningful observed thermal variation suitable for evaluating a versioned demo excursion policy.

test_objectives.name: data_quality_evaluation
test_objectives.description: Observed time-series evidence must be evaluated using the frozen ColdProof data-quality policy without synthetic interpolation.

test_objectives.name: spatial_context_handling
test_objectives.description: Mendeley spatial evidence must be presented as independent supplemental thermal context and must not participate in time-based excursion duration.

test_objectives.name: multi_format_normalization
test_objectives.description: The same selected observed measurement content will later be re-encoded into vendor-inspired formats and normalized back to equivalent measurement content.

required: continuous timestamps within selected replay interval
sufficient duration to divide into four synthetic segments
preferred: post-event behavior visible if supported by source

required: source workbook and cell traceability preserved
forbidden_uses: causal explanation of Zenodo thermal behavior

composite_replay_constraints: preserve each source window original timestamp
do not calculate event duration across independent source windows
replay_policy.handover_boundary_rule: A synthetic handover boundary does not automatically terminate an observed thermal event.

vendor_format_plan.rule: Re-encode selected observed measurement content without creating new physical observations.

validation_invariants: Observed temperature values must remain unchanged.
Observed humidity values must remain unchanged.
Observed source timestamps must remain unchanged.
Every observed record must remain traceable to source asset and row or workbook cell.
Every synthetic mapping must declare origin.
No synthetic temperature may fill an observed source gap.
No duration may cross an independent replay boundary.
Mendeley records must never receive synthetic timestamps.
Mendeley illustrative context must not participate in time-based excursion calculation.
Derived findings must reference their input measurements and policy version.
DEMO_2_8C must remain explicitly labeled as an assumption.
Zenodo evidence mapped to TRANSPORT must still preserve its original cold-storage-room source context.
Vendor-inspired formats must not be presented as real commercial vendor integrations.
design_decisions_pending: Maximum gap allowed within one derived excursion
Reference method for independently verifying expected results
